theorem coe_singleUnit (g : G) :
    ((singleUnit g : (MonoidAlgebra ℚ G)ˣ) : MonoidAlgebra ℚ G) = MonoidAlgebra.single g 1

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.coe_inv_singleUnit
decls.statement:
theorem coe_inv_singleUnit (g : G) :
    (((singleUnit g)⁻¹ : (MonoidAlgebra ℚ G)ˣ) : MonoidAlgebra ℚ G) =
      MonoidAlgebra.single g⁻¹ 1

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.coeff_conj
decls.doc:
Conjugating in the group algebra conjugates the indices of the coefficients.  Private: this is
group-algebra plumbing for the conjugation computations below.
decls.statement:
theorem coeff_conj (g h : G) (x : MonoidAlgebra ℚ G) :
    (MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : ℚ) * x * MonoidAlgebra.single g⁻¹ 1).coeff h =
      x.coeff (g⁻¹ * h * g)

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.rowSubgroup_relabel
decls.doc: Relabeling by `σ` conjugates the row group by `σ`.
decls.statement:
theorem rowSubgroup_relabel :
    rowSubgroup (relabel σ t) = (rowSubgroup t).map (MulAut.conj σ).toMonoidHom

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.colSubgroup_relabel
decls.doc: Relabeling by `σ` conjugates the column group by `σ`.
decls.statement:
theorem colSubgroup_relabel :
    colSubgroup (relabel σ t) = (colSubgroup t).map (MulAut.conj σ).toMonoidHom

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.mem_rowSubgroup_relabel
decls.doc:
A permutation preserves the rows of the relabeled tableau exactly when its conjugate preserves
the rows of the original one.

Not a `simp` lemma: `mem_rowSubgroup` and `rowIndex_relabel` already simplify the left-hand side
past this normal form, to the pointwise condition on rows.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_rowSubgroup_relabel {τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)} :
    τ ∈ rowSubgroup (relabel σ t) ↔ σ⁻¹ * τ * σ ∈ rowSubgroup t

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.mem_colSubgroup_relabel
decls.doc:
A permutation preserves the columns of the relabeled tableau exactly when its conjugate
preserves the columns of the original one.

Not a `simp` lemma: `mem_colSubgroup` and `colIndex_relabel` already simplify the left-hand side
past this normal form, to the pointwise condition on columns.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_colSubgroup_relabel {τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)} :
    τ ∈ colSubgroup (relabel σ t) ↔ σ⁻¹ * τ * σ ∈ colSubgroup t

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.rowSymmetrizer_relabel
decls.doc: Relabeling by `σ` conjugates the row symmetrizer by `σ`.
decls.statement:
theorem rowSymmetrizer_relabel :
    rowSymmetrizer (relabel σ t) =
      MonoidAlgebra.single σ 1 * rowSymmetrizer t * MonoidAlgebra.single σ⁻¹ 1

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.columnAntisymmetrizer_relabel
decls.doc:
Relabeling by `σ` conjugates the column antisymmetrizer by `σ`; the signs are unchanged,
conjugate permutations having equal signs.
decls.statement:
theorem columnAntisymmetrizer_relabel :
    columnAntisymmetrizer (relabel σ t) =
      MonoidAlgebra.single σ 1 * columnAntisymmetrizer t * MonoidAlgebra.single σ⁻¹ 1

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.youngSymmetrizer_relabel
decls.doc: Relabeling by `σ` conjugates the Young symmetrizer by `σ`: `c_{σt} = σ c_t σ⁻¹`.
decls.statement:
theorem youngSymmetrizer_relabel :
    youngSymmetrizer (relabel σ t) =
      MonoidAlgebra.single σ 1 * youngSymmetrizer t * MonoidAlgebra.single σ⁻¹ 1

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.mem_spechtIdeal_relabel_iff
decls.doc:
Membership in the left ideal generated by `c_{σt}` is membership in the right translate by
`σ⁻¹` of the left ideal generated by `c_t`.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_spechtIdeal_relabel_iff {x : MonoidAlgebra ℚ (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card))} :
    x ∈ spechtIdeal (relabel σ t) ↔ x * MonoidAlgebra.single σ 1 ∈ spechtIdeal t

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.spechtIdealRelabelEquiv
decls.doc:
Right multiplication by `σ` as an equivalence of left `ℚ[Sₙ]`-modules from `ℚ[Sₙ] c_{σt}` to
`ℚ[Sₙ] c_t`: it is right multiplication by the unit `σ` of the group algebra, restricted to the
two ideals.
decls.statement:
def spechtIdealRelabelEquiv :
    spechtIdeal (relabel σ t) ≃ₗ[MonoidAlgebra ℚ (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card))] spechtIdeal t

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.spechtIdealRelabelEquiv_apply_coe
decls.statement:
theorem spechtIdealRelabelEquiv_apply_coe (x : spechtIdeal (relabel σ t)) :
    (spechtIdealRelabelEquiv σ t x : MonoidAlgebra ℚ (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card))) =
      (x : MonoidAlgebra ℚ (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card))) * MonoidAlgebra.single σ 1

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.spechtIdealRelabelEquiv_symm_apply_coe
decls.statement:
theorem spechtIdealRelabelEquiv_symm_apply_coe (y : spechtIdeal t) :
    ((spechtIdealRelabelEquiv σ t).symm y : MonoidAlgebra ℚ (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card))) =
      (y : MonoidAlgebra ℚ (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card))) * MonoidAlgebra.single σ⁻¹ 1

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.spechtIdealRelabelRepEquiv
decls.doc:
Right multiplication by `σ` is an isomorphism of representations from `ℚ[Sₙ] c_{σt}` to
`ℚ[Sₙ] c_t`: being a map of left modules over the group algebra, it commutes with the action.
decls.statement:
def spechtIdealRelabelRepEquiv :
    (spechtIdealRep (relabel σ t)).ρ.Equiv (spechtIdealRep t).ρ

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.spechtIdealRelabelRepEquiv_apply_coe
decls.statement:
theorem spechtIdealRelabelRepEquiv_apply_coe (x : spechtIdeal (relabel σ t)) :
    (spechtIdealRelabelRepEquiv σ t x : MonoidAlgebra ℚ (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card))) =
      (x : MonoidAlgebra ℚ (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card))) * MonoidAlgebra.single σ 1

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.spechtIdealRelabelRepIso
decls.doc:
The left ideals of the Young symmetrizers of a tableau and of its relabelings are isomorphic
representations.
decls.statement: def spechtIdealRelabelRepIso : spechtIdealRep (relabel σ t) ≅ spechtIdealRep t

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.spechtIdealRelabelRepIso_hom_hom_apply_coe
decls.statement:
theorem spechtIdealRelabelRepIso_hom_hom_apply_coe (x : spechtIdeal (relabel σ t)) :
    ((spechtIdealRelabelRepIso σ t).hom.hom x : MonoidAlgebra ℚ (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card))) =
      (x : MonoidAlgebra ℚ (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card))) * MonoidAlgebra.single σ 1

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.finrank_spechtIdeal_relabel
decls.doc: Relabeling does not change the dimension of the Young-symmetrizer left ideal.
decls.statement:
theorem finrank_spechtIdeal_relabel :
    Module.finrank ℚ (spechtIdeal (relabel σ t)) = Module.finrank ℚ (spechtIdeal t)

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.character_spechtIdealRep_relabel
decls.doc: Relabeling does not change the character of the Young-symmetrizer left ideal.
decls.statement:
theorem character_spechtIdealRep_relabel :
    (spechtIdealRep (relabel σ t)).ρ.character = (spechtIdealRep t).ρ.character

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.character_spechtIdealFDRep_relabel
decls.doc: Relabeling does not change the character of the bundled Young-symmetrizer representation.
decls.statement:
theorem character_spechtIdealFDRep_relabel :
    (spechtIdealFDRep (relabel σ t)).character = (spechtIdealFDRep t).character

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.spechtIdealRepIso
decls.doc:
The Young-symmetrizer left ideals of two tableaux of the same shape are isomorphic
representations: up to isomorphism the representation depends only on the shape.
decls.statement: def spechtIdealRepIso : spechtIdealRep t ≅ spechtIdealRep t'

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.finrank_spechtIdeal_eq
decls.doc: The dimension of the Young-symmetrizer left ideal depends only on the shape of the tableau.
decls.statement:
theorem finrank_spechtIdeal_eq :
    Module.finrank ℚ (spechtIdeal t) = Module.finrank ℚ (spechtIdeal t')

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.character_spechtIdealRep_eq
decls.doc: The character of the Young-symmetrizer left ideal depends only on the shape of the tableau.
decls.statement:
theorem character_spechtIdealRep_eq :
    (spechtIdealRep t).ρ.character = (spechtIdealRep t').ρ.character

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.character_spechtIdealFDRep_eq
decls.doc:
The character of the bundled Young-symmetrizer representation depends only on the shape of the
tableau.
decls.statement:
theorem character_spechtIdealFDRep_eq :
    (spechtIdealFDRep t).character = (spechtIdealFDRep t').character

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.rowSubgroup
decls.doc:
The **row group** of a `μ`-tableau: the permutations of the labels that keep every label in
its own row of `t`.
decls.statement: def rowSubgroup (t : YoungTableau μ) : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card))

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.colSubgroup
decls.doc:
The **column group** of a `μ`-tableau: the permutations of the labels that keep every label in
its own column of `t`.
decls.statement: def colSubgroup (t : YoungTableau μ) : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card))

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.mem_rowSubgroup
decls.statement:
theorem mem_rowSubgroup {t : YoungTableau μ} {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)} :
    σ ∈ rowSubgroup t ↔ ∀ k, rowIndex t (σ k) = rowIndex t k

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.mem_colSubgroup
decls.statement:
theorem mem_colSubgroup {t : YoungTableau μ} {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)} :
    σ ∈ colSubgroup t ↔ ∀ k, colIndex t (σ k) = colIndex t k

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.rowSubgroup_def
decls.doc: The row group of `t` is the group of permutations preserving the fibers of `rowIndex t`.
decls.statement:
theorem rowSubgroup_def (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    rowSubgroup t = fiberSubgroup (rowIndex t)

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.colSubgroup_def
decls.doc: The column group of `t` is the group of permutations preserving the fibers of `colIndex t`.
decls.statement:
theorem colSubgroup_def (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    colSubgroup t = fiberSubgroup (colIndex t)

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.swap_mem_rowSubgroup
decls.doc: The transposition of two labels lying in a common row of `t` belongs to the row group.
decls.statement:
theorem swap_mem_rowSubgroup {t : YoungTableau μ} {x y : Fin μ.card}
    (h : rowIndex t x = rowIndex t y) : Equiv.swap x y ∈ rowSubgroup t

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.swap_mem_colSubgroup
decls.doc:
The transposition of two labels lying in a common column of `t` belongs to the column
group.
decls.statement:
theorem swap_mem_colSubgroup {t : YoungTableau μ} {x y : Fin μ.card}
    (h : colIndex t x = colIndex t y) : Equiv.swap x y ∈ colSubgroup t

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.rowSubgroup_inf_colSubgroup_eq_bot
decls.doc:
The row and column groups of a `μ`-tableau meet only in the identity: a permutation of the
labels that stays inside the rows and inside the columns fixes every cell.
decls.statement:
theorem rowSubgroup_inf_colSubgroup_eq_bot (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    rowSubgroup t ⊓ colSubgroup t = ⊥

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.disjoint_rowSubgroup_colSubgroup
decls.doc:
The row and column groups of a `μ`-tableau are disjoint subgroups of the symmetric group on
the labels.
decls.statement:
theorem disjoint_rowSubgroup_colSubgroup (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    Disjoint (rowSubgroup t) (colSubgroup t)

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.rowSubgroupMulEquiv
decls.doc:
The row group of a `μ`-tableau is the product, over the rows of `μ`, of the symmetric groups
of the rows.  Rows beyond the last one of `μ` are empty and contribute trivial factors.
decls.statement:
def rowSubgroupMulEquiv (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    rowSubgroup t ≃* ∀ i, Equiv.Perm ↥(μ.row i)

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.colSubgroupMulEquiv
decls.doc:
The column group of a `μ`-tableau is the product, over the columns of `μ`, of the symmetric
groups of the columns.
decls.statement:
def colSubgroupMulEquiv (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    colSubgroup t ≃* ∀ j, Equiv.Perm ↥(μ.col j)

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.rowSubgroupMulEquiv_apply_coe
decls.doc:
The `i`-th component of `rowSubgroupMulEquiv t σ` moves the cell carrying the label `k` to the
cell carrying the label `σ k`.
decls.statement:
theorem rowSubgroupMulEquiv_apply_coe (t : YoungTableau μ) (σ : rowSubgroup t) (i : ℕ)
    (k : {k : Fin μ.card // rowIndex t k = i}) :
    (rowSubgroupMulEquiv t σ i (rowFiberEquiv t i k) : ℕ × ℕ) =
      (t.symm ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)) k) : ℕ × ℕ)

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.colSubgroupMulEquiv_apply_coe
decls.doc:
The `j`-th component of `colSubgroupMulEquiv t σ` moves the cell carrying the label `k` to the
cell carrying the label `σ k`.
decls.statement:
theorem colSubgroupMulEquiv_apply_coe (t : YoungTableau μ) (σ : colSubgroup t) (j : ℕ)
    (k : {k : Fin μ.card // colIndex t k = j}) :
    (colSubgroupMulEquiv t σ j (colFiberEquiv t j k) : ℕ × ℕ) =
      (t.symm ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)) k) : ℕ × ℕ)

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.rowSubgroupMulEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc:
The permutation of the labels assembled from a family of permutations of the rows of `μ` moves
each label by the permutation of its own row.
decls.statement:
theorem rowSubgroupMulEquiv_symm_apply (t : YoungTableau μ) (σ : ∀ i, Equiv.Perm ↥(μ.row i))
    (k : Fin μ.card) :
    (((rowSubgroupMulEquiv t).symm σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)) k : Fin μ.card) =
      ((rowFiberEquiv t (rowIndex t k)).symm
        (σ (rowIndex t k) (rowFiberEquiv t (rowIndex t k) ⟨k, rfl⟩)) : Fin μ.card)

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.colSubgroupMulEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc:
The permutation of the labels assembled from a family of permutations of the columns of `μ`
moves each label by the permutation of its own column.
decls.statement:
theorem colSubgroupMulEquiv_symm_apply (t : YoungTableau μ) (σ : ∀ j, Equiv.Perm ↥(μ.col j))
    (k : Fin μ.card) :
    (((colSubgroupMulEquiv t).symm σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)) k : Fin μ.card) =
      ((colFiberEquiv t (colIndex t k)).symm
        (σ (colIndex t k) (colFiberEquiv t (colIndex t k) ⟨k, rfl⟩)) : Fin μ.card)

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.ofModule'_apply
decls.doc:
`Representation.ofModule'` has no public application lemma, so this private bridge
isolates its definitional reduction to the group-algebra action.
decls.statement:
theorem ofModule'_apply
    {k G M : Type*} [CommSemiring k] [Monoid G] [AddCommMonoid M]
    [Module k M] [Module (MonoidAlgebra k G) M]
    [IsScalarTower k (MonoidAlgebra k G) M]
    (g : G) (x : M) :
    Representation.ofModule' (k := k) (G := G) M g x =
      MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : k) • x

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.spechtIdeal
decls.doc: The principal left ideal `ℚ[Sₙ] c_t` generated by the Young symmetrizer of `t`.

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.spechtIdeal_le_iff
decls.doc:
The Young-symmetrizer left ideal is contained in a submodule exactly when that
submodule contains its generator.
decls.statement:
theorem spechtIdeal_le_iff (t : YoungTableau μ)
    (I : Submodule (MonoidAlgebra ℚ (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)))
      (MonoidAlgebra ℚ (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)))) :
    spechtIdeal t ≤ I ↔ youngSymmetrizer t ∈ I

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.mem_spechtIdeal_iff
decls.doc: An element lies in `ℚ[Sₙ] c_t` exactly when it is a left multiple of `c_t`.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_spechtIdeal_iff (t : YoungTableau μ)
    (x : MonoidAlgebra ℚ (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card))) :
    x ∈ spechtIdeal t ↔
      ∃ a : MonoidAlgebra ℚ (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)),
        a * youngSymmetrizer t = x

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.youngSymmetrizer_mem_spechtIdeal
decls.doc: The Young symmetrizer belongs to the left ideal that it generates.
decls.statement:
theorem youngSymmetrizer_mem_spechtIdeal (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    youngSymmetrizer t ∈ spechtIdeal t

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.spechtIdeal_eq_bot_iff
decls.doc: The Young-symmetrizer left ideal is zero exactly when its generator is zero.
decls.statement:
theorem spechtIdeal_eq_bot_iff (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    spechtIdeal t = ⊥ ↔ youngSymmetrizer t = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.spechtIdeal_ne_bot
decls.doc: The Young-symmetrizer left ideal is nonzero.
decls.statement:
theorem spechtIdeal_ne_bot (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    spechtIdeal t ≠ ⊥

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.instNontrivialSpechtIdeal
decls.doc: A Young-symmetrizer left ideal is a nontrivial module.
decls.statement:
instance instNontrivialSpechtIdeal (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    Nontrivial (spechtIdeal t)

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.spechtIdealRep
decls.doc: The representation of the symmetric group on `ℚ[Sₙ] c_t` by left multiplication.
decls.statement:
abbrev spechtIdealRep (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    Rep ℚ (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card))

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.spechtIdealRep_ρ_apply_coe
decls.doc:
The action on the Young-symmetrizer left ideal is multiplication on the left by the
corresponding group-algebra basis element.
decls.statement:
theorem spechtIdealRep_ρ_apply_coe (t : YoungTableau μ)
    (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card))
    (x : spechtIdeal t) :
    ((spechtIdealRep t).ρ g x :
      MonoidAlgebra ℚ (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card))) =
      MonoidAlgebra.single g 1 *
        (x : MonoidAlgebra ℚ (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)))

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.instModuleFiniteSpechtIdeal
decls.doc: A Young-symmetrizer left ideal is finite-dimensional over `ℚ`.
decls.statement:
instance instModuleFiniteSpechtIdeal (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    Module.Finite ℚ (spechtIdeal t)

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.spechtIdealFDRep
decls.doc:
The left ideal generated by a Young symmetrizer, bundled as a finite-dimensional
representation.
decls.statement:
abbrev spechtIdealFDRep (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    FDRep ℚ (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card))

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.finrank_spechtIdeal_pos
decls.doc: The Young-symmetrizer left ideal has positive dimension.
decls.statement:
theorem finrank_spechtIdeal_pos (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    0 < Module.finrank ℚ (spechtIdealFDRep t)

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.finrank_spechtIdeal_le_factorial
decls.doc:
The dimension of `ℚ[Sₙ] c_t` is at most `n!`, the dimension of the regular
representation.
decls.statement:
theorem finrank_spechtIdeal_le_factorial (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    Module.finrank ℚ (spechtIdealFDRep t) ≤ μ.card.factorial

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.instDecidablePredPermFinCardMemSubgroupRowSubgroup
decls.doc: Classical decidability of membership in the row group, used to form its finite sum.
decls.statement: instance (t : YoungTableau μ) : DecidablePred (· ∈ rowSubgroup t)

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.instDecidablePredPermFinCardMemSubgroupColSubgroup
decls.doc: Classical decidability of membership in the column group, used to form its finite sum.
decls.statement: instance (t : YoungTableau μ) : DecidablePred (· ∈ colSubgroup t)

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.permSign_cast_mul_self
decls.statement:
theorem permSign_cast_mul_self (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)) :
    ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℚ) * ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℚ) = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.rowSymmetrizer
decls.doc: The **row symmetrizer** `a_t`, the sum of the permutations preserving the rows of `t`.
decls.statement:
def rowSymmetrizer (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    MonoidAlgebra ℚ (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card))

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.columnAntisymmetrizer
decls.doc:
The **column antisymmetrizer** `b_t`, the signed sum of the permutations preserving the
columns of `t`.
decls.statement:
def columnAntisymmetrizer (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    MonoidAlgebra ℚ (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card))

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.youngSymmetrizer
decls.doc:
The **Young symmetrizer** of `t`, with the convention `c_t = a_t b_t`: first
row-symmetrize, then column-antisymmetrize.
decls.statement:
def youngSymmetrizer (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    MonoidAlgebra ℚ (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card))

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.rowSymmetrizer_def
decls.doc: The row symmetrizer is the sum of the basis elements indexed by the row group.
decls.statement:
theorem rowSymmetrizer_def (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    rowSymmetrizer t =
      ∑ p : rowSubgroup t, MonoidAlgebra.of ℚ (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)) p

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.columnAntisymmetrizer_def
decls.doc:
The column antisymmetrizer is the sign-weighted sum of the basis elements indexed by the
column group.
decls.statement:
theorem columnAntisymmetrizer_def (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    columnAntisymmetrizer t =
      ∑ q : colSubgroup t,
        ((Equiv.Perm.sign (q : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)) : ℤ) : ℚ) •
          MonoidAlgebra.of ℚ (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)) q

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.youngSymmetrizer_def
decls.doc: The Young symmetrizer uses the row-then-column convention `c_t = a_t b_t`.
decls.statement:
theorem youngSymmetrizer_def (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    youngSymmetrizer t = rowSymmetrizer t * columnAntisymmetrizer t

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.rowSymmetrizer_coeff
decls.doc: The coefficient of a permutation in the row symmetrizer is its row-group indicator.
decls.statement:
theorem rowSymmetrizer_coeff (t : YoungTableau μ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)) :
    (rowSymmetrizer t).coeff σ = if σ ∈ rowSubgroup t then 1 else 0

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.columnAntisymmetrizer_coeff
decls.doc:
The coefficient of a permutation in the column antisymmetrizer is its sign on the column
group and zero off that group.
decls.statement:
theorem columnAntisymmetrizer_coeff (t : YoungTableau μ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)) :
    (columnAntisymmetrizer t).coeff σ =
      if σ ∈ colSubgroup t then ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℚ) else 0

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.mul_rowSymmetrizer_left
decls.doc: Left multiplication by a member of the row group fixes the row symmetrizer.
decls.statement:
theorem mul_rowSymmetrizer_left (t : YoungTableau μ) (p : rowSubgroup t) :
    MonoidAlgebra.single (p : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)) 1 * rowSymmetrizer t =
      rowSymmetrizer t

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.mul_rowSymmetrizer_right
decls.doc: Right multiplication by a member of the row group fixes the row symmetrizer.
decls.statement:
theorem mul_rowSymmetrizer_right (t : YoungTableau μ) (p : rowSubgroup t) :
    rowSymmetrizer t * MonoidAlgebra.single (p : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)) 1 =
      rowSymmetrizer t

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.mul_columnAntisymmetrizer_left
decls.doc:
Left multiplication by a member of the column group scales the column antisymmetrizer by
the sign of that member.
decls.statement:
theorem mul_columnAntisymmetrizer_left (t : YoungTableau μ) (q : colSubgroup t) :
    MonoidAlgebra.single (q : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)) 1 * columnAntisymmetrizer t =
      ((Equiv.Perm.sign (q : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)) : ℤ) : ℚ) •
        columnAntisymmetrizer t

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.mul_columnAntisymmetrizer_right
decls.doc:
Right multiplication by a member of the column group scales the column antisymmetrizer by
the sign of that member.
decls.statement:
theorem mul_columnAntisymmetrizer_right (t : YoungTableau μ) (q : colSubgroup t) :
    columnAntisymmetrizer t * MonoidAlgebra.single (q : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)) 1 =
      ((Equiv.Perm.sign (q : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)) : ℤ) : ℚ) •
        columnAntisymmetrizer t

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.rowSymmetrizer_sq
decls.doc: The row symmetrizer squares to the order of the row group times itself.
decls.statement:
theorem rowSymmetrizer_sq (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    rowSymmetrizer t * rowSymmetrizer t =
      Nat.card (rowSubgroup t) • rowSymmetrizer t

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.columnAntisymmetrizer_sq
decls.doc: The column antisymmetrizer squares to the order of the column group times itself.
decls.statement:
theorem columnAntisymmetrizer_sq (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    columnAntisymmetrizer t * columnAntisymmetrizer t =
      Nat.card (colSubgroup t) • columnAntisymmetrizer t

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.mul_youngSymmetrizer_left
decls.doc: The row group fixes the Young symmetrizer on the left.
decls.statement:
theorem mul_youngSymmetrizer_left (t : YoungTableau μ) (p : rowSubgroup t) :
    MonoidAlgebra.single (p : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)) 1 * youngSymmetrizer t =
      youngSymmetrizer t

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.mul_youngSymmetrizer_right
decls.doc: The column group acts on the Young symmetrizer on the right through its sign character.
decls.statement:
theorem mul_youngSymmetrizer_right (t : YoungTableau μ) (q : colSubgroup t) :
    youngSymmetrizer t * MonoidAlgebra.single (q : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)) 1 =
      ((Equiv.Perm.sign (q : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)) : ℤ) : ℚ) •
        youngSymmetrizer t

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.youngSymmetrizer_coeff_one
decls.doc: The coefficient of the identity permutation in a Young symmetrizer is one.
decls.statement:
theorem youngSymmetrizer_coeff_one (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    (youngSymmetrizer t).coeff 1 = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.youngSymmetrizer_ne_zero
decls.doc: A Young symmetrizer is nonzero.
decls.statement:
theorem youngSymmetrizer_ne_zero (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    youngSymmetrizer t ≠ 0

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.shapePartition
decls.statement: abbrev shapePartition (μ : YoungDiagram) : μ.card.Partition

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.shapePartition_sortedParts
decls.statement:
theorem shapePartition_sortedParts (μ : YoungDiagram) :
    (shapePartition μ).parts.sort (· ≥ ·) = μ.rowLens

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.rowBlocks
decls.statement: abbrev rowBlocks (l : List ℕ) : Type

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.rowCellsEquiv
decls.statement:
def rowCellsEquiv (μ : YoungDiagram) :
    rowBlocks μ.rowLens ≃ ↥μ.cells

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.sortedBlocksEquivRows
decls.statement:
def sortedBlocksEquivRows (μ : YoungDiagram) :
    rowBlocks ((shapePartition μ).parts.sort (· ≥ ·)) ≃ rowBlocks μ.rowLens

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.cast_rowBlocks_fst
decls.statement:
theorem cast_rowBlocks_fst {l₁ l₂ : List ℕ} (h : l₁ = l₂)
    (x : rowBlocks l₁) :
    ((Equiv.cast (congrArg rowBlocks h) x).1 : ℕ) = x.1

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.cast_rowBlocks_snd
decls.statement:
theorem cast_rowBlocks_snd {l₁ l₂ : List ℕ} (h : l₁ = l₂)
    (x : rowBlocks l₁) :
    ((Equiv.cast (congrArg rowBlocks h) x).2 : ℕ) = x.2

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.sortedBlocksEquivRows_fst
decls.statement:
theorem sortedBlocksEquivRows_fst (μ : YoungDiagram)
    (x : rowBlocks ((shapePartition μ).parts.sort (· ≥ ·))) :
    ((sortedBlocksEquivRows μ x).1 : ℕ) = x.1

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.sortedBlocksEquivRows_snd
decls.statement:
theorem sortedBlocksEquivRows_snd (μ : YoungDiagram)
    (x : rowBlocks ((shapePartition μ).parts.sort (· ≥ ·))) :
    ((sortedBlocksEquivRows μ x).2 : ℕ) = x.2

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.rowYoungConjugator
decls.doc:
The permutation carrying the consecutive-block labeling of a Young diagram to the labeling
of `t`. It sends each block of the shape partition to the correspondingly numbered row of `t`.
decls.statement:
def rowYoungConjugator {μ : YoungDiagram} (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.rowIndex_rowYoungConjugator
decls.doc: The row of a label after applying `rowYoungConjugator t` is its consecutive-block number.
decls.statement:
theorem rowIndex_rowYoungConjugator {μ : YoungDiagram} (t : YoungTableau μ)
    (k : Fin μ.card) :
    rowIndex t (rowYoungConjugator t k) =
      youngBlock ((partitionEquivYoungDiagram μ.card).symm ⟨μ, rfl⟩) k

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.rowYoungConjugator_youngBlocksEquiv
decls.doc:
On consecutive-block coordinates, `rowYoungConjugator t` sends position `j` in block `i`
to the label in position `j` of row `i` of `t`.
decls.statement:
theorem rowYoungConjugator_youngBlocksEquiv {μ : YoungDiagram} (t : YoungTableau μ)
    (x : Σ i : Fin
        (((partitionEquivYoungDiagram μ.card).symm ⟨μ, rfl⟩).parts.sort (· ≥ ·)).length,
      Fin ((((partitionEquivYoungDiagram μ.card).symm ⟨μ, rfl⟩).parts.sort (· ≥ ·)).get i)) :
    rowYoungConjugator t
        (youngBlocksEquiv ((partitionEquivYoungDiagram μ.card).symm ⟨μ, rfl⟩) x) =
      t ⟨(x.1, x.2), by
        rw [YoungDiagram.mem_cells, YoungDiagram.mem_iff_lt_rowLen]
        let y := sortedBlocksEquivRows μ x
        calc
          (x.2 : ℕ) = y.2 := (sortedBlocksEquivRows_snd μ x).symm
          _ < μ.rowLens.get y.1 := y.2.2
          _ = μ.rowLen y.1 := YoungDiagram.get_rowLens
          _ = μ.rowLen x.1 := congrArg μ.rowLen (sortedBlocksEquivRows_fst μ x)⟩

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.youngSubgroup_map_conj_eq_rowSubgroup
decls.doc:
Conjugation by `rowYoungConjugator t` carries the Young subgroup of the shape partition
onto the row group of `t`.
decls.statement:
theorem youngSubgroup_map_conj_eq_rowSubgroup {μ : YoungDiagram} (t : YoungTableau μ) :
    (youngSubgroup ((partitionEquivYoungDiagram μ.card).symm ⟨μ, rfl⟩)).map
        (MulAut.conj (rowYoungConjugator t)).toMonoidHom = rowSubgroup t

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.youngSubgroupConjMulEquiv
decls.doc:
Conjugation by `rowYoungConjugator t` as a multiplicative equivalence from the Young
subgroup of the shape partition to the row group of `t`.

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.youngSubgroupConjMulEquiv_apply_coe
decls.doc: The subgroup equivalence acts by conjugation with `rowYoungConjugator t`.
decls.statement:
theorem youngSubgroupConjMulEquiv_apply_coe {μ : YoungDiagram} (t : YoungTableau μ)
    (σ : youngSubgroup ((partitionEquivYoungDiagram μ.card).symm ⟨μ, rfl⟩)) :
    ((youngSubgroupConjMulEquiv t σ : rowSubgroup t) : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)) =
      rowYoungConjugator t * σ * (rowYoungConjugator t)⁻¹

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.youngSubgroupConjMulEquiv_symm_apply_coe
decls.doc:
The inverse subgroup equivalence acts by conjugation with the inverse of
`rowYoungConjugator t`.
decls.statement:
theorem youngSubgroupConjMulEquiv_symm_apply_coe {μ : YoungDiagram} (t : YoungTableau μ)
    (τ : rowSubgroup t) :
    (((youngSubgroupConjMulEquiv t).symm τ :
        youngSubgroup ((partitionEquivYoungDiagram μ.card).symm ⟨μ, rfl⟩)) :
      Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)) =
      (rowYoungConjugator t)⁻¹ * τ * rowYoungConjugator t

decls.name: PiTensorProduct.reindexRepresentation
decls.doc:
The representation of the permutation group of `ι` on the `ι`-indexed tensor power,
acting by reindexing the tensor factors.
decls.statement:
def reindexRepresentation :
    Representation R (Equiv.Perm ι) (⨂[R] _ : ι, M)

decls.name: PiTensorProduct.reindexRepresentation_apply
decls.doc: The permutation representation acts by `PiTensorProduct.reindex`.
decls.statement:
theorem reindexRepresentation_apply (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) :
    reindexRepresentation R M ι σ = (reindex R (fun _ : ι => M) σ).toLinearMap

decls.name: PiTensorProduct.commute_reindexRepresentation_map
decls.doc: Permuting factors commutes with applying the same linear map in every tensor factor.
decls.statement:
theorem commute_reindexRepresentation_map (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) (f : M →ₗ[R] M) :
    Commute (reindexRepresentation R M ι σ) (map fun _ : ι => f)

decls.name: PiTensorProduct.commute_reindexRepresentation_asAlgebraHom_map
decls.doc:
Every element of the group algebra commutes with applying the same linear map in every
tensor factor.
decls.statement:
theorem commute_reindexRepresentation_asAlgebraHom_map
    (a : MonoidAlgebra R (Equiv.Perm ι)) (f : M →ₗ[R] M) :
    Commute ((reindexRepresentation R M ι).asAlgebraHom a) (map fun _ : ι => f)

decls.name: PiTensorProduct.reindexRepresentation_asAlgebraHom_apply_tprod
decls.doc:
The group-algebra action on a pure tensor is the corresponding finite linear combination
of reindexed pure tensors.
decls.statement:
theorem reindexRepresentation_asAlgebraHom_apply_tprod
    (a : MonoidAlgebra R (Equiv.Perm ι)) (m : ι → M) :
    (reindexRepresentation R M ι).asAlgebraHom a (tprod R m) =
      a.coeff.sum fun σ r => r • tprod R (fun i => m (σ.symm i))

decls.name: TauCeti.permTensorAction
decls.doc: The symmetric-group action on `(Fin n → R)^{⊗d}` by permutation of tensor factors.
decls.statement:
def permTensorAction :
    Representation R (Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) (⨂[R] _ : Fin d, Fin n → R)

decls.name: TauCeti.permTensorAction_def
decls.doc:
The symmetric-group action on `(Fin n → R)^{⊗d}` is the reindexing representation for the
index type `Fin d`.
decls.statement:
theorem permTensorAction_def :
    permTensorAction R n d = PiTensorProduct.reindexRepresentation R (Fin n → R) (Fin d)

decls.name: TauCeti.permTensorAction_apply
decls.doc: A permutation acts on `(Fin n → R)^{⊗d}` by `PiTensorProduct.reindex`.
decls.statement:
theorem permTensorAction_apply (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) :
    permTensorAction R n d σ =
      (PiTensorProduct.reindex R (fun _ : Fin d => Fin n → R) σ).toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.permTensorActionAlgHom
decls.doc:
The group-algebra action of `R[S_d]` on `(Fin n → R)^{⊗d}` induced by factor
permutations.

decls.name: TauCeti.permTensorActionAlgHom_def
decls.doc: The group-algebra action of `R[S_d]` is the linear extension of `permTensorAction`.
decls.statement:
theorem permTensorActionAlgHom_def :
    permTensorActionAlgHom R n d = (permTensorAction R n d).asAlgebraHom

decls.name: TauCeti.permTensorActionAlgHom_of
decls.doc: A single permutation, viewed in the group algebra, acts by `permTensorAction`.
decls.statement:
theorem permTensorActionAlgHom_of (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) :
    permTensorActionAlgHom R n d (MonoidAlgebra.of R (Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) σ) =
      permTensorAction R n d σ

decls.name: TauCeti.permTensorActionAlgHom_apply_tprod
decls.doc:
The group-algebra action on a pure tensor of `(Fin n → R)^{⊗d}` is the corresponding finite
linear combination of reindexed pure tensors.
decls.statement:
theorem permTensorActionAlgHom_apply_tprod (a : MonoidAlgebra R (Equiv.Perm (Fin d)))
    (m : Fin d → (Fin n → R)) :
    permTensorActionAlgHom R n d a (PiTensorProduct.tprod R m) =
      a.coeff.sum fun σ r => r • PiTensorProduct.tprod R fun i => m (σ.symm i)

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.RowMeetsColumnTwice
decls.doc:
A row of the tableau `t` **meets a column** of the tableau `s` **twice** if two distinct
labels lie in a common row of `t` and in a common column of `s`.  A row of `t` and a column of `t`
share at most one label, so meeting once is no condition at all and it is the second shared label
that carries the content.  The relation is not symmetric: rows are read off `t` and columns off
`s`.
decls.statement: def RowMeetsColumnTwice (t s : YoungTableau μ) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.rowMeetsColumnTwice_def
decls.doc:
The defining characterisation of `RowMeetsColumnTwice`, for introducing and eliminating the
predicate on arbitrary tableaux.  Not a `simp` lemma: it would shadow the normal forms
`rowMeetsColumnTwice_relabel_iff` and `not_rowMeetsColumnTwice_self`.
decls.statement:
theorem rowMeetsColumnTwice_def (t s : YoungTableau μ) :
    RowMeetsColumnTwice t s ↔
      ∃ x y, x ≠ y ∧ rowIndex t x = rowIndex t y ∧ colIndex s x = colIndex s y

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.rowMeetsColumnTwice_relabel_iff
decls.doc:
A row of `t` meets a column of the relabelling `relabel σ t` exactly when two distinct labels
of a common row of `t` have their `σ`-preimages in a common column of `t`.
decls.statement:
theorem rowMeetsColumnTwice_relabel_iff (t : YoungTableau μ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)) :
    RowMeetsColumnTwice t (relabel σ t) ↔
      ∃ x y, x ≠ y ∧ rowIndex t x = rowIndex t y ∧
        colIndex t (σ⁻¹ x) = colIndex t (σ⁻¹ y)

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.not_rowMeetsColumnTwice_self
decls.doc:
No row of a tableau meets one of its own columns twice: a label is determined by its row
together with its column.
decls.statement: theorem not_rowMeetsColumnTwice_self (t : YoungTableau μ) : ¬RowMeetsColumnTwice t t

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.exists_rowMeetsColumnTwice_relabel
decls.doc:
The criterion is satisfiable as soon as `t` has a row containing two distinct labels and a
column containing two distinct labels: some relabelling of `t` then has a column meeting that row
twice.  Concretely one moves `x` and `y` onto `u` and `v` and relabels by the inverse.
decls.statement:
theorem exists_rowMeetsColumnTwice_relabel (t : YoungTableau μ) {x y u v : Fin μ.card} (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hrow : rowIndex t x = rowIndex t y) (huv : u ≠ v) (hcol : colIndex t u = colIndex t v) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card), RowMeetsColumnTwice t (relabel σ t)

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.rowSymmetrizer_mul_single_mul_columnAntisymmetrizer_eq_zero
decls.doc:
**The key vanishing lemma**, in terms of explicit labels: if the distinct labels `x` and `y`
lie in a common row of `t` while their `σ`-preimages lie in a common column of `t`, then the
sandwich `a_t σ b_t` vanishes.
decls.title: The key vanishing lemma
decls.statement:
theorem rowSymmetrizer_mul_single_mul_columnAntisymmetrizer_eq_zero (t : YoungTableau μ)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)) {x y : Fin μ.card} (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hrow : rowIndex t x = rowIndex t y)
    (hcol : colIndex t (σ⁻¹ x) = colIndex t (σ⁻¹ y)) :
    rowSymmetrizer t * MonoidAlgebra.single σ (1 : ℚ) * columnAntisymmetrizer t = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.RowMeetsColumnTwice.rowSymmetrizer_mul_single_mul_columnAntisymmetrizer_eq_zero
decls.doc:
**The key vanishing lemma.**  If a row of `t` meets a column of the relabelled tableau
`relabel σ t` in two distinct labels, then the sandwich `a_t σ b_t` vanishes.
decls.title: The key vanishing lemma
decls.statement:
theorem RowMeetsColumnTwice.rowSymmetrizer_mul_single_mul_columnAntisymmetrizer_eq_zero
    {t : YoungTableau μ} {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)} (h : RowMeetsColumnTwice t (relabel σ t)) :
    rowSymmetrizer t * MonoidAlgebra.single σ (1 : ℚ) * columnAntisymmetrizer t = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.rowSymmetrizer_mul_single_mul_columnAntisymmetrizer_eq_sign_smul_youngSymmetrizer
decls.doc:
A permutation lying in the product of the row and the column group has its sandwich equal to
the Young symmetrizer, up to the sign of its column part.
decls.statement:
theorem rowSymmetrizer_mul_single_mul_columnAntisymmetrizer_eq_sign_smul_youngSymmetrizer
    (t : YoungTableau μ) {p q : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)} (hp : p ∈ rowSubgroup t)
    (hq : q ∈ colSubgroup t) :
    rowSymmetrizer t * MonoidAlgebra.single (p * q) (1 : ℚ) * columnAntisymmetrizer t =
      ((Equiv.Perm.sign q : ℤ) : ℚ) • youngSymmetrizer t

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.rowSymmetrizer_mul_single_mul_columnAntisymmetrizer_ne_zero
decls.doc:
A permutation lying in the product of the row and the column group has a nonzero
sandwich.
decls.statement:
theorem rowSymmetrizer_mul_single_mul_columnAntisymmetrizer_ne_zero (t : YoungTableau μ)
    {p q : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)} (hp : p ∈ rowSubgroup t) (hq : q ∈ colSubgroup t) :
    rowSymmetrizer t * MonoidAlgebra.single (p * q) (1 : ℚ) * columnAntisymmetrizer t ≠ 0

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.not_rowMeetsColumnTwice_relabel_mul
decls.doc:
No row of `t` meets a column of `relabel (p * q) t` twice, when `p` lies in the row group and
`q` in the column group: the two labels would share a row and a column of `t` itself.
decls.statement:
theorem not_rowMeetsColumnTwice_relabel_mul (t : YoungTableau μ)
    {p q : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)} (hp : p ∈ rowSubgroup t) (hq : q ∈ colSubgroup t) :
    ¬RowMeetsColumnTwice t (relabel (p * q) t)

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.notMem_mul_of_rowMeetsColumnTwice
decls.doc:
A permutation on which the row/column criterion fires lies outside the product set
`Row(t) · Col(t)`.
decls.statement:
theorem notMem_mul_of_rowMeetsColumnTwice {t : YoungTableau μ} {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)}
    (h : RowMeetsColumnTwice t (relabel σ t)) :
    σ ∉ (rowSubgroup t : Set (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card))) *
      (colSubgroup t : Set (Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card)))

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.exists_rowSymmetrizer_mul_single_mul_columnAntisymmetrizer_eq_zero
decls.doc:
The vanishing lemma is not vacuous: a tableau with a row containing two distinct labels and a
column containing two distinct labels admits a permutation whose sandwich vanishes.
decls.statement:
theorem exists_rowSymmetrizer_mul_single_mul_columnAntisymmetrizer_eq_zero (t : YoungTableau μ)
    {x y u v : Fin μ.card} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hrow : rowIndex t x = rowIndex t y) (huv : u ≠ v)
    (hcol : colIndex t u = colIndex t v) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin μ.card),
      rowSymmetrizer t * MonoidAlgebra.single σ (1 : ℚ) * columnAntisymmetrizer t = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.not_rowMeetsColumnTwice_relabel_of_ne_zero
decls.doc:
The contrapositive of the key vanishing lemma: a nonzero sandwich forces every two distinct
labels of a common row of `t` into distinct columns of `relabel σ t`.

decls.name: TauCeti.youngBlocksEquiv
decls.doc:
The equivalence which enumerates the consecutive blocks whose sizes are the decreasing parts
of `μ`.

The coordinate `⟨i, j⟩` denotes position `j` in block `i`.

decls.name: TauCeti.youngBlocksEquiv_apply
decls.doc:
The consecutive-block equivalence sends a local coordinate to the preceding block sizes
plus that coordinate.
decls.statement:
theorem youngBlocksEquiv_apply {n : ℕ} (μ : n.Partition)
    (x : Σ i : Fin (μ.parts.sort (· ≥ ·)).length,
      Fin ((μ.parts.sort (· ≥ ·)).get i)) :
    (youngBlocksEquiv μ x : ℕ) =
      ∑ i : Fin x.1,
        (μ.parts.sort (· ≥ ·)).get (Fin.castLE x.1.2.le i) + x.2

decls.name: TauCeti.youngBlock
decls.doc: The block containing an element of `Fin n`.
decls.statement:
def youngBlock {n : ℕ} (μ : n.Partition) (j : Fin n) :
    Fin (μ.parts.sort (· ≥ ·)).length

decls.name: TauCeti.youngBlock_youngBlocksEquiv
decls.doc: The block-coordinate equivalence sends a local coordinate to its block label.
decls.statement:
theorem youngBlock_youngBlocksEquiv {n : ℕ} (μ : n.Partition)
    (x : Σ i : Fin (μ.parts.sort (· ≥ ·)).length,
      Fin ((μ.parts.sort (· ≥ ·)).get i)) :
    youngBlock μ (youngBlocksEquiv μ x) = x.1

decls.name: TauCeti.youngBlockEquiv
decls.doc: The local coordinates in block `i` are equivalent to the fiber of `youngBlock μ` over `i`.

decls.name: TauCeti.youngBlockEquiv_apply
decls.doc:
The block-fiber equivalence is the consecutive-block equivalence with its block-membership
proof.
decls.statement:
theorem youngBlockEquiv_apply {n : ℕ} (μ : n.Partition)
    (i : Fin (μ.parts.sort (· ≥ ·)).length)
    (j : Fin ((μ.parts.sort (· ≥ ·))[(i : ℕ)])) :
    youngBlockEquiv μ i j =
      ⟨youngBlocksEquiv μ ⟨i, j⟩, youngBlock_youngBlocksEquiv μ ⟨i, j⟩⟩

decls.name: TauCeti.youngBlockEquiv_val
decls.statement:
theorem youngBlockEquiv_val {n : ℕ} (μ : n.Partition)
    (i : Fin (μ.parts.sort (· ≥ ·)).length)
    (j : Fin ((μ.parts.sort (· ≥ ·))[(i : ℕ)])) :
    (youngBlockEquiv μ i j).1 = youngBlocksEquiv μ ⟨i, j⟩

decls.name: TauCeti.youngSubgroup
decls.doc:
The Young subgroup associated to `μ`, acting independently on the consecutive blocks whose
sizes are the decreasing parts of `μ`.
decls.statement:
def youngSubgroup {n : ℕ} (μ : n.Partition) :
    Subgroup (Equiv.Perm (Fin n))

decls.name: TauCeti.youngSubgroupStabilizerMulEquiv
TauCeti.mem_youngSubgroup_stabilizer_iff
decls.statement:
theorem mem_youngSubgroup_stabilizer_iff {n : ℕ} (μ : n.Partition)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    σ ∈ youngSubgroup μ ↔
      DomMulAct.mk σ ∈
        MulAction.stabilizer (Equiv.Perm (Fin n))ᵈᵐᵃ (youngBlock μ)

decls.name: TauCeti.youngSubgroupMulEquiv
decls.doc: The Young subgroup is the product of the symmetric groups on its consecutive blocks.
decls.statement:
def youngSubgroupMulEquiv {n : ℕ} (μ : n.Partition) :
    youngSubgroup μ ≃*
      (∀ i : Fin (μ.parts.sort (· ≥ ·)).length,
        Equiv.Perm (Fin ((μ.parts.sort (· ≥ ·)).get i)))

decls.name: TauCeti.youngSubgroupStabilizerMulEquiv_apply
decls.statement:
theorem youngSubgroupStabilizerMulEquiv_apply {n : ℕ} (μ : n.Partition)
    (σ : youngSubgroup μ) :
    DomMulAct.mk.symm (youngSubgroupStabilizerMulEquiv μ σ).unop =
      (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))

decls.name: TauCeti.youngSubgroupMulEquiv_apply
decls.statement:
theorem youngSubgroupMulEquiv_apply {n : ℕ} (μ : n.Partition)
    (σ : youngSubgroup μ) (i : Fin (μ.parts.sort (· ≥ ·)).length) :
    youngSubgroupMulEquiv μ σ i =
      (youngBlockEquiv μ i).symm.permCongrHom
        ((DomMulAct.stabilizerMulEquiv (youngBlock μ))
          (youngSubgroupStabilizerMulEquiv μ σ) i)

decls.name: TauCeti.youngSubgroupMulEquiv_apply_youngBlocksEquiv
decls.doc: The product decomposition records the local coordinate induced on each consecutive block.
decls.statement:
theorem youngSubgroupMulEquiv_apply_youngBlocksEquiv {n : ℕ} (μ : n.Partition)
    (σ : youngSubgroup μ) (i : Fin (μ.parts.sort (· ≥ ·)).length)
    (j : Fin ((μ.parts.sort (· ≥ ·)).get i)) :
    (youngBlocksEquiv μ).symm
        ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (youngBlocksEquiv μ ⟨i, j⟩)) =
      ⟨i, (youngSubgroupMulEquiv μ σ) i j⟩

decls.name: TauCeti.youngSubgroupMulEquiv_symm_apply_youngBlocksEquiv
decls.doc:
The inverse product decomposition acts on each consecutive block by the corresponding
permutation.
decls.statement:
theorem youngSubgroupMulEquiv_symm_apply_youngBlocksEquiv {n : ℕ} (μ : n.Partition)
    (p : ∀ i : Fin (μ.parts.sort (· ≥ ·)).length,
      Equiv.Perm (Fin ((μ.parts.sort (· ≥ ·)).get i)))
    (i : Fin (μ.parts.sort (· ≥ ·)).length)
    (j : Fin ((μ.parts.sort (· ≥ ·)).get i)) :
    ((youngSubgroupMulEquiv μ).symm p : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
        (youngBlocksEquiv μ ⟨i, j⟩) =
      youngBlocksEquiv μ ⟨i, p i j⟩

decls.name: TauCeti.prod_factorial_sorted_parts
decls.statement:
theorem prod_factorial_sorted_parts {n : ℕ} (μ : n.Partition) :
    (∏ i : Fin (μ.parts.sort (· ≥ ·)).length,
        ((μ.parts.sort (· ≥ ·)).get i).factorial) =
      (μ.parts.map Nat.factorial).prod

decls.name: TauCeti.card_youngSubgroup
decls.doc: The order of a Young subgroup is the product of the factorials of the parts.
decls.statement:
theorem card_youngSubgroup {n : ℕ} (μ : n.Partition) :
    Nat.card (youngSubgroup μ) = (μ.parts.map Nat.factorial).prod

decls.name: TauCeti.mem_youngSubgroup_iff
decls.doc: Membership in the Young subgroup is equivalent to preserving the consecutive-block label.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_youngSubgroup_iff {n : ℕ} (μ : n.Partition) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    σ ∈ youngSubgroup μ ↔ youngBlock μ ∘ σ = youngBlock μ

decls.name: TauCeti.youngSubgroup_eq_fiberSubgroup
decls.doc: The Young subgroup is the subgroup preserving the fibers of its consecutive-block map.
decls.statement:
theorem youngSubgroup_eq_fiberSubgroup {n : ℕ} (μ : n.Partition) :
    youngSubgroup μ = fiberSubgroup (youngBlock μ)

decls.name: TauCeti.youngSubgroup_index_mul
decls.doc: The index of a Young subgroup times its order is `n!`.
decls.statement:
theorem youngSubgroup_index_mul {n : ℕ} (μ : n.Partition) :
    (youngSubgroup μ).index * (μ.parts.map Nat.factorial).prod = n.factorial

decls.name: TauCeti.youngSubgroup_index
decls.doc: The index of a Young subgroup is the multinomial quotient by the factorials of the parts.
decls.statement:
theorem youngSubgroup_index {n : ℕ} (μ : n.Partition) :
    (youngSubgroup μ).index =
      n.factorial / (μ.parts.map Nat.factorial).prod

decls.name: Representation.symmetricPower
decls.doc: The action induced by a representation on its `d`th symmetric power.
decls.statement:
def symmetricPower (ρ : Representation R G M) (d : ℕ) :
    Representation R G (Sym[R]^d M)

decls.name: Representation.symmetricPower_apply
decls.doc: The action on a symmetric power is induced by the action on the original representation.
decls.statement:
theorem symmetricPower_apply (ρ : Representation R G M) (d : ℕ) (g : G) :
    ρ.symmetricPower d g = SymmetricPower.map (ι := Fin d) (ρ g)

decls.name: Representation.symmetricPower_apply_tprod
decls.doc:
The symmetric-power action applies the original action to every factor of a pure tensor.

This is intentionally not a simp lemma: `symmetricPower_apply` followed by
`SymmetricPower.map_tprod` already performs this simplification.
decls.statement:
theorem symmetricPower_apply_tprod (ρ : Representation R G M) (d : ℕ) (g : G)
    (m : Fin d → M) :
    ρ.symmetricPower d g (⨂ₛ[R] i, m i) = ⨂ₛ[R] i, ρ g (m i)

decls.name: Representation.IntertwiningMap.symmetricPower
decls.doc: An intertwining map induces an intertwining map on every symmetric power.
decls.statement:
def symmetricPower (f : IntertwiningMap ρ σ) (d : ℕ) :
    IntertwiningMap (ρ.symmetricPower d) (σ.symmetricPower d)

decls.name: Representation.IntertwiningMap.symmetricPower_toLinearMap
decls.doc: The underlying linear map is the usual map induced on symmetric powers.
decls.statement:
theorem symmetricPower_toLinearMap (f : IntertwiningMap ρ σ) (d : ℕ) :
    (f.symmetricPower d).toLinearMap =
      SymmetricPower.map (ι := Fin d) f.toLinearMap

decls.name: Representation.IntertwiningMap.symmetricPower_apply_tprod
decls.doc: The induced map sends a pure symmetric tensor to the tensor of the images.
decls.statement:
theorem symmetricPower_apply_tprod (f : IntertwiningMap ρ σ) (d : ℕ) (m : Fin d → M) :
    f.symmetricPower d (⨂ₛ[R] i, m i) = ⨂ₛ[R] i, f (m i)

decls.name: Representation.IntertwiningMap.symmetricPower_id
decls.doc: Symmetric powers preserve identity intertwining maps.
decls.statement:
theorem symmetricPower_id (d : ℕ) :
    (IntertwiningMap.id ρ).symmetricPower d =
      IntertwiningMap.id (ρ.symmetricPower d)

decls.name: Representation.IntertwiningMap.symmetricPower_comp
decls.doc: Symmetric powers preserve composition of intertwining maps.
decls.statement:
theorem symmetricPower_comp {P : Type*} [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P]
    {τ : Representation R G P} (f : IntertwiningMap ρ σ) (g : IntertwiningMap σ τ) (d : ℕ) :
    (g.comp f).symmetricPower d =
      (g.symmetricPower d).comp (f.symmetricPower d)

decls.name: Representation.Equiv.symmetricPowerLinearEquiv
decls.doc:
The linear equivalence induced on `d`th symmetric powers by an equivalence of
representations.
decls.statement:
def symmetricPowerLinearEquiv (e : ρ.Equiv σ) (d : ℕ) :
    (Sym[R]^d M) ≃ₗ[R] (Sym[R]^d N)

decls.name: Representation.Equiv.symmetricPowerLinearEquiv_toLinearMap
decls.statement:
theorem symmetricPowerLinearEquiv_toLinearMap (e : ρ.Equiv σ) (d : ℕ) :
    (symmetricPowerLinearEquiv e d).toLinearMap =
      SymmetricPower.map (ι := Fin d) e.toLinearMap

decls.name: Representation.Equiv.symmetricPowerLinearEquiv_symm_toLinearMap
decls.statement:
theorem symmetricPowerLinearEquiv_symm_toLinearMap (e : ρ.Equiv σ) (d : ℕ) :
    (symmetricPowerLinearEquiv e d).symm.toLinearMap =
      SymmetricPower.map (ι := Fin d) e.symm.toLinearMap

decls.name: Representation.Equiv.symmetricPower
decls.doc: An equivalence of representations induces an equivalence of every symmetric power.
decls.statement:
def symmetricPower (e : ρ.Equiv σ) (d : ℕ) :
    (ρ.symmetricPower d).Equiv (σ.symmetricPower d)

decls.name: Representation.Equiv.symmetricPower_toLinearEquiv
decls.statement:
theorem symmetricPower_toLinearEquiv (e : ρ.Equiv σ) (d : ℕ) :
    (e.symmetricPower d).toLinearEquiv = symmetricPowerLinearEquiv e d

decls.name: Representation.Equiv.symmetricPower_toLinearMap
decls.doc: The underlying linear map is the usual map induced on symmetric powers.
decls.statement:
theorem symmetricPower_toLinearMap (e : ρ.Equiv σ) (d : ℕ) :
    (e.symmetricPower d).toLinearMap =
      SymmetricPower.map (ι := Fin d) e.toLinearMap

decls.name: Representation.Equiv.symmetricPower_apply_tprod
decls.doc: The induced equivalence sends a pure symmetric tensor to the tensor of the images.
decls.statement:
theorem symmetricPower_apply_tprod (e : ρ.Equiv σ) (d : ℕ) (m : Fin d → M) :
    e.symmetricPower d (⨂ₛ[R] i, m i) = ⨂ₛ[R] i, e (m i)

decls.name: Representation.Equiv.symmetricPower_refl
decls.doc: Symmetric powers preserve identity equivalences.
decls.statement:
theorem symmetricPower_refl (d : ℕ) :
    (Equiv.refl ρ).symmetricPower d = .refl (ρ.symmetricPower d)

decls.name: Representation.Equiv.symmetricPower_symm
decls.doc: Symmetric powers preserve inverses of equivalences.
decls.statement:
theorem symmetricPower_symm (e : ρ.Equiv σ) (d : ℕ) :
    e.symm.symmetricPower d = (e.symmetricPower d).symm

decls.name: Representation.Equiv.symmetricPower_trans
decls.doc: Symmetric powers preserve composition of equivalences.
decls.statement:
theorem symmetricPower_trans {P : Type*} [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P]
    {τ : Representation R G P} (e : ρ.Equiv σ) (f : σ.Equiv τ) (d : ℕ) :
    (e.trans f).symmetricPower d =
      (e.symmetricPower d).trans (f.symmetricPower d)

decls.name: TauCeti.TensorPower.map_fin_zero
decls.doc:
A family of linear maps indexed by `Fin 0` acts as the identity on the zero-fold tensor
power.
decls.statement:
theorem map_fin_zero (f : Fin 0 → M →ₗ[R] M) :
    PiTensorProduct.map f = LinearMap.id

decls.name: TauCeti.TensorPower.append_const
decls.statement:
theorem append_const {α : Type*} {d e : ℕ} (x : α) :
    Fin.append (fun _ : Fin d => x) (fun _ : Fin e => x) = fun _ : Fin (d + e) => x

decls.name: TauCeti.TensorPower.mulEquiv_map
decls.statement:
theorem mulEquiv_map {d e : ℕ} (f : Fin d → M →ₗ[R] M)
    (g : Fin e → M →ₗ[R] M) :
    (_root_.TensorPower.mulEquiv :
      (⨂[R]^d M) ⊗[R] (⨂[R]^e M) ≃ₗ[R] (⨂[R]^(d + e) M)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map (PiTensorProduct.map f) (PiTensorProduct.map g) =
      PiTensorProduct.map (Fin.append f g) ∘ₗ
        (_root_.TensorPower.mulEquiv :
          (⨂[R]^d M) ⊗[R] (⨂[R]^e M) ≃ₗ[R] (⨂[R]^(d + e) M)).toLinearMap

decls.name: TauCeti.TensorPower.mulEquiv_conj_map
decls.doc:
Splitting a tensor power intertwines separate families of maps on the two factors with
their appended family on the combined tensor power.
decls.statement:
theorem mulEquiv_conj_map {d e : ℕ} (f : Fin d → M →ₗ[R] M) (g : Fin e → M →ₗ[R] M) :
    (_root_.TensorPower.mulEquiv :
      (⨂[R]^d M) ⊗[R] (⨂[R]^e M) ≃ₗ[R] (⨂[R]^(d + e) M)).conj
        (TensorProduct.map (PiTensorProduct.map f) (PiTensorProduct.map g)) =
      PiTensorProduct.map (Fin.append f g)

decls.name: Representation.tensorPower
decls.doc: The diagonal action of `G` on the `d`-fold tensor power of a representation.
decls.statement:
def tensorPower (ρ : Representation R G M) (d : ℕ) :
    Representation R G (⨂[R]^d M)

decls.name: Representation.tensorPower_apply
decls.doc: The tensor-power action applies the original action in every tensor factor.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorPower_apply (ρ : Representation R G M) (d : ℕ) (g : G) :
    ρ.tensorPower d g = PiTensorProduct.map fun _ : Fin d => ρ g

decls.name: Representation.tensorPower_zero_apply
decls.doc:
The action on the zero-fold tensor power is the identity.

This is intentionally not a simp lemma: `tensorPower_apply` followed by
`TauCeti.TensorPower.map_fin_zero` already performs this simplification.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorPower_zero_apply (ρ : Representation R G M) (g : G) :
    ρ.tensorPower 0 g = LinearMap.id

decls.name: Representation.tensorPowerAddEquiv
decls.doc:
Splitting the factors gives an equivalence from the tensor product of two tensor-power
representations to the tensor power indexed by their sum.
decls.statement:
def tensorPowerAddEquiv (ρ : Representation R G M) (d e : ℕ) :
    ((ρ.tensorPower d).tprod (ρ.tensorPower e)).Equiv (ρ.tensorPower (d + e))

decls.name: Representation.char_tensorPower
decls.doc: The character of a tensor-power representation is the corresponding power of the character.
decls.statement:
theorem char_tensorPower (ρ : Representation R G M) (d : ℕ) (g : G) :
    (ρ.tensorPower d).character g = (ρ.character g) ^ d

decls.name: TauCeti.TensorSquare.toTensorPower_ιMulti_two
decls.statement:
theorem toTensorPower_ιMulti_two {R : Type} {M : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (f : Fin 2 → M) :
    exteriorPower.toTensorPower R M 2 (exteriorPower.ιMulti R 2 f) =
      PiTensorProduct.tprod R f -
        PiTensorProduct.tprod R (fun i ↦ f (Equiv.swap 0 1 i))

decls.name: TauCeti.TensorSquare.mk_comp_toTensorPower
decls.statement:
theorem mk_comp_toTensorPower {R : Type} {M : Type*}
    [Field R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] :
    (SymmetricPower.mk R (Fin 2) M).comp
      (exteriorPower.toTensorPower R M 2) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.TensorSquare.symToAlternatingQuotient
decls.statement:
def symToAlternatingQuotient {R : Type} {M : Type*}
    [Field R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] :
    Sym[R]^2 M →ₗ[R]
      (⨂[R]^2 M) ⧸ LinearMap.range (exteriorPower.toTensorPower R M 2)

decls.name: TauCeti.TensorSquare.symToAlternatingQuotient_mk
decls.statement:
theorem symToAlternatingQuotient_mk {R : Type} {M : Type*}
    [Field R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (x : ⨂[R]^2 M) :
    symToAlternatingQuotient (R := R) (M := M)
        (SymmetricPower.mk R (Fin 2) M x) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk x

decls.name: TauCeti.TensorSquare.range_toTensorPower_eq_ker_mk
decls.statement:
theorem range_toTensorPower_eq_ker_mk {R : Type} {M : Type*}
    [Field R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] :
    LinearMap.range (exteriorPower.toTensorPower R M 2) =
      LinearMap.ker (SymmetricPower.mk R (Fin 2) M)

decls.name: TauCeti.TensorSquare.pairingDual_ιMulti_apply
decls.statement:
theorem pairingDual_ιMulti_apply {R : Type} {M : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (g : Fin 2 → Module.Dual R M) (x : ⋀[R]^2 M) :
    exteriorPower.pairingDual R M 2 (exteriorPower.ιMulti R 2 g) x =
      TensorPower.multilinearMapToDual R M 2 g (exteriorPower.toTensorPower R M 2 x)

decls.name: TauCeti.TensorSquare.toTensorPower_injective
TauCeti.TensorSquare.trace_eq_add_of_exact
decls.statement:
theorem trace_eq_add_of_exact
    {K A B C : Type*} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup A] [Module K A] [FiniteDimensional K A]
    [AddCommGroup B] [Module K B]
    [AddCommGroup C] [Module K C] [FiniteDimensional K C]
    (i : A →ₗ[K] B) (q : B →ₗ[K] C)
    (fA : A →ₗ[K] A) (fB : B →ₗ[K] B) (fC : C →ₗ[K] C)
    (hi : Function.Injective i) (hq : Function.Surjective q)
    (hexact : LinearMap.range i = LinearMap.ker q)
    (hfi : fB.comp i = i.comp fA) (hfq : q.comp fB = fC.comp q) :
    LinearMap.trace K B fB =
      LinearMap.trace K A fA + LinearMap.trace K C fC

decls.name: Representation.tensorSquareEquivSymmetricExterior
decls.doc:
The tensor square of a representation is equivalent to the product of its symmetric and
exterior squares when `2` is invertible.
decls.statement:
def tensorSquareEquivSymmetricExterior (ρ : Representation R G M) :
    (ρ.tensorPower 2).Equiv ((ρ.symmetricPower 2).prod (ρ.exteriorPower 2))

decls.name: Representation.tensorSquareEquivSymmetricExterior_toLinearEquiv
decls.doc:
The underlying linear equivalence of the tensor-square decomposition is the natural
linear-algebraic decomposition.
decls.statement:
theorem tensorSquareEquivSymmetricExterior_toLinearEquiv (ρ : Representation R G M) :
    ρ.tensorSquareEquivSymmetricExterior.toLinearEquiv =
      TauCeti.tensorSquareEquivSymmetricExterior R M

decls.name: Representation.char_tensorSquare
decls.doc:
Over any field, the tensor-square character is the sum of the symmetric-square and
exterior-square characters.
decls.statement:
theorem char_tensorSquare (ρ : Representation R G M) (g : G) :
    (ρ.character g) ^ 2 =
      (ρ.symmetricPower 2).character g + (ρ.exteriorPower 2).character g
